properties.description: A PR writes changelog.d/<slug>.md under Keep a Changelog headings instead of editing CHANGELOG.md; tools/changelog_fragments.py --check (CI) refuses a malformed fragment or an entry written straight into [Unreleased]; --cut <version> assembles the fragments into CHANGELOG.md under the new version, grouped by section, and removes them. Two PRs never edit one spot. Option (b) of dec:idea-how-changelog-md-gets-written-once-the-design-is-the-record (Anthony, 2026-10-03).
properties.name: Each pull request writes its CHANGELOG entry as its own fragment, and the cut assembles them
